summary: Iteration 2 validates the expanded Artigo model (materiais recipe + roteiro with máquina + mão de obra) and the new Consumíveis & Mão de Obra modules. 11/11 backend pytest tests pass. Frontend E2E confirmed: Artigos / Materiais / Mão de Obra dialogs all open on button click, real-time cost calculation works (Materiais 2,40€ + Máquinas 10,00€ + Mão de Obra 18,00€ = 30,40€ Custo Total Calculado updated as the user filled material qty / minutes), Save persists and the new artigo shows in the table with the correct breakdown. Seeded DTF UV breakdown verified at exactly 1,60 / 1,73 / 1,20 / 4,53 €. Orçamento line auto-fills custo_producao_unit from the artigo's computed cost and applies global margem correctly. Conversion to OF auto-loads roteiro with tempo_min = min_maquina + min_mao_obra.

issues: React hydration console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Caused by an icon/span being rendered inside a native <option>. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up (use plain text in <option> only).

action_items: Optional: remove the <span> child rendered inside <option> tags in Artigos.jsx selects (material-select-*, op-maquina-*, op-maoobra-*) to silence the React hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py artigo_breakdown() correctly fetches custo_hora from /maquinas and /mao-obra collections at compute time (so price changes flow into all artigos automatically). Good.
POST/PUT /api/artigos return enriched object with custo_materiais / custo_maquinas / custo_mao_obra / custo_producao_total — frontend table consumes them directly. Good.
fill_linha_custos() resolves each orçamento line's artigo cost via artigo_custo_total(), so quotes always reflect the up-to-date cost. Good.

build_of_itens() computes tempo_min as min_maquina + min_mao_obra. This works visually for OF op cards but loses the maquina vs mão-obra split on the OF side; acceptable per spec which only requires showing maquina_nome + mao_obra_nome.

ArtigoMaterial snapshots custo_unitario at save time AND the breakdown also uses the stored value, not the live consumible price. If a consumível price changes, existing artigos keep the old per-unit price until they are re-saved. Worth confirming with product owner whether this is intended (snapshot-style) or should re-lookup from consumiveis (live-style). Current implementation = SNAPSHOT.
Native <select> options include an icon <span> child causing a React DOM warning (see frontend_issues).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (Artigos dialog with real-time calc, Materiais CRUD, MaoObra CRUD)

seed_data_creation: POST /api/seed idempotent. Creates 3 máquinas, 2 mão-obra, 4 consumíveis, 3 tipos, 2 artigos (DTF UV 4,53 € / DTF Têxtil 2,80 €). All TEST_ data created during this run was cleaned up afterwards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests are at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, parallel-safe via pytest-xdist). REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL must be set in env (read from /app/frontend/.env). The Artigos dialog (max-h-[92vh] overflow-y-auto) renders all sections at once; calc-materiais/calc-maquinas/calc-maoobra/calc-total are visible without scroll at 1920x1080. Native HTML <select> — use page.select_option() with the option's value, not its label.
rca of the issue: No bugs to RCA. The previously-flagged risk that shadcn Dialog might not open was confirmed false — both the Artigos large sectioned dialog and the simpler Materiais / MaoObra dialogs open correctly on button click and the real-time Custo Total Calculado block recomputes synchronously on every input change.
